newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: KEPCO shrs up on rate hike rumours.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO shrs up on rate hike rumours.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's state-run utility Korea Electric Power Corp rose 900 won to 24,900 on late morning trading on Friday.

Brokers said the shares were boosted by newspapers reports, which were later denied by the Ministry of Finance and Economy, that the government was mulling hiking electricity rates by the end of the year.
"The news of rate cuts is fueling interest in KEPCO," said an analyst with Shinyoung Securities.
But a ministry official said the reports were baseless. "They are completely wrong," he said.
